title: Decision Artifact Reference Schema
description: Non-normative public reference interface for representing the result of a governance evaluation in the VTI Deterministic Governance Reference.

decision_id.description: Unique identifier for the decision artifact.

request_id.description: Identifier for the proposed action or request that was evaluated.

outcome.description: Simplified public reference outcome vocabulary. This vocabulary is non-normative.

authority_state_id.description: Reference to the authority-state representation used in the evaluation.

evaluation_context_id.description: Identifier for the evaluation context, policy set, or implementation-defined ruleset used for the decision.

evaluated_at.description: Timestamp at which the evaluation result was produced.

valid_until.description: Optional timestamp after which the decision artifact should not be relied upon without reevaluation.

integrity_reference.description: Optional implementation-defined integrity or provenance reference associated with this artifact.

execution_reference.description: Optional reference to a downstream execution, transaction, receipt, or external system record.

metadata.description: Optional implementation-specific metadata. Consumers should not treat metadata as normative decision semantics.
